sections.title: Photographs
sections.note: DX only: the album The Travels of Link. No photos while BowWow or the Rooster follows you, and while Marin does only hers.

items.name: 1. Here Stands A Brave Man
items.howTo: Visit the Camera Shop and say yes to having your picture taken.
items.notes: Keep refusing and you get the alternate "Game Over" photo instead; you can only ever have one of them. No other photo can be taken before this one.

items.name: 2. Marin at the cliff
items.howTo: While Marin follows you, take her to the seaside cliff in the south-west of Toronbo Shores.
items.notes: Marin only follows you until the Walrus wakes. Zelda Dungeon says the south-east.

items.name: 3. Heads Up!
items.howTo: Jump into the Mabe Village well while Marin follows you.

items.name: 4. Say "Mushroom!"
items.howTo: Stand by the Weathercock in Mabe Village with Marin; Tarin squeezes into the shot.

items.name: 5. Link Discovers Ulrira's Secret!
items.howTo: Look in the right-hand window of Old Man Ulrira's house.

items.name: 6. Link Plays With BowWow!
items.howTo: Walk up to BowWow outside Madam MeowMeow's house.
items.notes: StrategyWiki: after you've brought him home from Bottle Grotto.

items.name: 7. Are you proud of yourself?
items.howTo: Steal something from the Town Tool Shop and come back.
items.notes: The shopkeeper calls you THIEF from then on and the album becomes The Travels of THIEF.

items.name: 8. Be more careful next time!
items.howTo: Talk to the fisherman under the Martha's Bay bridge.
items.notes: StrategyWiki and Zelda's Palace say you need the Magnifying Lens first; Zelda Dungeon says after you've given him the Fishing Hook.

items.name: 9. I Found Zora!
items.howTo: Look at the Zora in the north-east house of Animal Village through the Magnifying Lens.

items.name: 10. I've Just Decided to Wait at Home
items.howTo: Stand at Kanalet Castle's closed gate; Richard comes along.
items.notes: Gone once the gate has been opened.

items.name: 11. I Was Very Afraid
items.howTo: Go up to the Ghost's grave after you've taken him home.

items.name: 12. Close Call
items.howTo: Cross the bridge two screens east of the Hen House.
items.notes: Not while carrying the Flying Rooster.
